# 🏎️  **Formula 1 2026 Lap History (Live Dataset)** 🏎️ 

## 🏁 Latest Updates
29.03 - Japan
08.03 - Australia
15.03 - China
3.05 - Miami 
24.05 - Canada 

## 💡 About 
Every lap. Every driver. Every data point — from Bahrain Pre-Season Testing through to the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.

This dataset covers the full 2026 Formula One season, beginning with Pre-Season Testing Day 1 on 11 February 2026 and updated continuously through to the final lap of the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix on 6 December 2026. 

All data has been sourced programmatically using a combination of APIs, then cleaned, enriched, and validated so you can go straight to analysis — no preprocessing required.

## 🎯 **Who Is This For?**

This dataset is purpose-built for beginner to intermediate data analysts and machine learning enthusiasts who want to work with real, rich motorsport data without the usual data-wrangling overhead.

## 📦 What's included? 

All Drivers 
All 2026 Laps to date
Lap time 
Tyre Compound 
Tyre Age 
Telemetry (Speed, Throttle, Brake, Gear, RPM)
XYZ Location co-ordinates 


Telemetry & co-ordinates are provided in 0.5 second / 2Hz intervals 

Pre-season testing is available as a separate file

resources.description: One row per lap. Telemetry is a JSON array sampled at 0.5s.

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Grand Prix or test event name

fields.name: session_type
fields.description: Session code (FP1, FP2, FP3, Q, SQ, R, or test day)

fields.name: driver
fields.description: Driver code (e.g. LEC); falls back to driver number

fields.name: lap_duration
fields.description: Lap time in seconds (numeric, for ML)

fields.name: telemetry
fields.description: JSON array of 0.5s samples: t, speed, throttle, brake, gear, rpm, drs, x, y, z
